name: rainbow-button
title: Rainbow Button
description: An animated button with a rainbow effect.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RainbowButton } from '@/components/ui/rainbow-button'
</script>

<template>
  <RainbowButton>Get Unlimited Access</RainbowButton>
</template>

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the button. Override the rainbow with `[--color-1:…]` … `[--color-5:…]` and the speed with `[--speed:4s]`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Solid, or light with a rainbow underline.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render, e.g. `a` or `RouterLink` (Vue's take on `asChild`).

emits.name: click
emits.description: Native click (falls through to the element).
